answer.reason: The verses give Zechariah's prophesying alongside Haggai that helped the Jews finish building the house of God, which goes beyond the summary.

clauses.english: prophesied with Haggai, and the elders prospered in building the house of God through their prophesying
clauses.quote: they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo

doubts: ZEC 1:1, 1:7, 7:1 and 7:8 only record that the word of the LORD came to him, which is what the summary already says (prophet), so they were not used.
EZR 5:1 and 6:14 give his father as Iddo, whereas ZEC 1:1 gives Berechiah, son of Iddo; the Ezra verses are treated as naming the same man.
